'''K1l-R''' was a personal bodyguard [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and a friend of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] named [[Tookra]]. The droid could operate in both [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and [[Crab/Legends|crab]]-like forms. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] Tookra ordered K1l-R to eliminate [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who failed to perform the delivery the Geonosian requested, which cost him a large sum of money. Solo, however, manage to escape in his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. K1l-R and Tookra followed him in Tookra's ship and caught with him on the planet of [[Cataalda]]. The gigantic droid attacked Solo and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who tried to escape it until they caught up with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dust (bounty hunter)|Dust]]. K1l-R destroyed the bounty hunter's ship and in an act of revenge Dust destroyed the droid by ripping its head off.
